children.name: Idiosepius paradoxus
children.description: Idiosepius paradoxus, also known as the northern pygmy squid, is a species of pygmy squid native to the western Pacific Ocean. This species can be found inhabiting shallow, inshore waters around central China, South Korea, and Japan.

children.name: Idiosepius picteti
children.description: Idiosepius picteti is a species of pygmy squid native to the Indo-Pacific waters off eastern Indonesia.

children.name: Xipholeptos notoides
children.description: Xipholeptos is a genus of squid in the family Idiosepiidae. It is monotypic, being represented by the single species Xipholeptos notoides, commonly known as the southern pygmy squid. The species was originally classified as Idiosepius notoides.
